title: Concept: CodeIgniter uncaught-exception page disclosed
description: The CodeIgniter exception view prints the failing file, the line and a stack of frames. That tells the caller the document root, the framework version layout and which controller raised the error, which is the map for the next request.
applicability: Responses from a PHP application that leaves the development environment enabled.
risk: The caller learns the filesystem layout and the code path, then targets the controller or parameter that raised the error.
